name: animated-toast
title: Animated Toast
description: Brief messages that stack in the corner and can be swiped away.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, toasts included. Any theme but Default also tints the timer bar.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: variant
props.label: Variant
props.description: Kind of message. Loading → success shows a spinner, then succeeds after a moment.

props.name: showDescription
props.label: Description
props.description: Adds a second line of detail under the title.

props.name: collapsibleDescription
props.label: Collapsible description
props.description: Long descriptions fold to one line with a toggle to expand. Needs Description on.

props.name: showAction
props.label: Show action
props.description: Adds an Undo button to the toast.

props.name: timeout
props.label: Stays for
props.description: How long a toast stays before closing itself, in seconds. 0 keeps it until dismissed.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: Toasts spring in with a slight overshoot.

props.name: originFromTrigger
props.label: Origin from trigger
props.description: Toasts grow out of the button that opened them.

props.name: fadeContent
props.label: Fade content
props.description: The toast's text fades in just after the toast arrives.

props.name: exitAnimation
props.label: Exit animation
props.description: How a toast leaves when it closes.

props.name: tiltOnSwipe
props.label: Tilt on swipe
props.description: Toasts tilt in the direction you swipe them away.

props.name: morphIcon
props.label: Loading → tick morph
props.description: The loading spinner morphs into a tick on success. Only for the Loading → success variant, or after Undo with Show action on.

props.name: showTimerBar
props.label: Show timer bar
props.description: A bar shrinks to show the time left. Not used with Stays for 0; with Loading → success it appears after the success.

props.name: showAccentEdge
props.label: Show accent edge
props.description: A coloured line on the edge for success, info, warning and error toasts. Not used by Default.

props.name: position
props.label: Position
props.description: Where on the screen toasts stack.
